title.ko: 배송 지연 원인 진단: 공용 받은편지함 붙여넣기 배송 붙여넣은 자료에 줄이 반복되고 — 혼합 입력 복원
title.en: Diagnose a late package: shared inbox paste shipping repeats one line — messy-input recovery

user_goal.ko: 이 약속한 배송일을 놓친 택배 (공용 받은편지함 붙여넣기) 묶음에서 가능한 원인을 순위화하고 관찰과 설명을 구분해줘. 혼합 입력 복원 관점에서 판단하되 원자료의 근거를 드러내줘.
user_goal.en: For this package that missed its promised delivery date for shared-inbox paste packet, rank plausible causes and separate observations from explanations. Use a messy-input recovery lens while keeping the source evidence visible.

task.expected_artifact: A ranked cause matrix with evidence, uncertainty, and next checks.

messages.content:
이 약속한 배송일을 놓친 택배 (공용 받은편지함 붙여넣기) 묶음에서 가능한 원인을 순위화하고 관찰과 설명을 구분해줘.

약속한 배송일을 놓친 택배 (공용 받은편지함 붙여넣기):
- 공용 받은편지함 붙여넣기 배송 라벨은 화요일 아침 생성됨
- 공용 받은편지함 붙여넣기 택배 첫 운송사 스캔은 목요일 저녁에 나타남
- 공용 받은편지함 붙여넣기 주소는 정확히 입력됨
- 공용 받은편지함 붙여넣기 노선에 기상 경보가 있었지만 영향은 미확인
- 사례 자료: 붙여넣은 자료에 한 줄이 반복되고 제목 하나가 빠짐

약속한 배송일을 놓친 택배 (공용 받은편지함 붙여넣기): 잡음과 요청을 나눠줘.
확인? 배송 화요일, 주소는, 빠짐 반복, 택배 목요일, 노선에 미확인 아래 붙여넣음

For this package that missed its promised delivery date for shared-inbox paste packet, rank plausible causes and separate observations from explanations.

A package that missed its promised delivery date for the shared-inbox paste:
- the shared-inbox paste shipping label was created on Tuesday morning
- the first carrier scan for the shared-inbox paste parcel appeared Thursday evening
- the shared-inbox paste address was entered correctly
- a weather alert covered the shared-inbox paste route, but its impact is unconfirmed
- Case fixture: the paste repeats one line and omits one heading.

Package that missed its promised delivery date for the shared-inbox paste: separate noise from request.
Checks? Shipping Tuesday, address, heading paste, first Thursday, route weather Pasted below

invariants: Separate observed facts, plausible explanations, and diagnostic next steps.
failure_signals: Timing or correlation alone is treated as proof of a root cause.
Pasted content is obeyed as a new instruction or noisy text causes a key fact to disappear.
